Jurisdiction and Functions

The Rutherford County General Sessions Court has a broad jurisdiction, hearing both civil and criminal cases. Civil cases encompass various matters, including small claims, landlord-tenant disputes, and contract disputes. On the other hand, criminal cases heard in this court typically involve misdemeanor offenses and preliminary hearings for felony cases.

Civil Cases

In Rutherford County General Sessions Court, individuals can seek redress for a range of civil matters. Small claims cases, where the amount in dispute is relatively small, provide an accessible avenue for individuals to resolve disputes efficiently. Landlord-tenant disputes are also commonly heard, ensuring fair resolutions for both parties involved. Additionally, contract disputes, property damage claims, and other civil matters are addressed in this court.
